verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְאָסָֽף׃ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל־ דֳּמִי־ לָ֑ךְ אַל־ תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְאַל־ תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šîr miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’al- do·mî- lāḵ ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš wə·’al- tiš·qōṭ ’êl
verses.literal: A song A Psalm of Asaph O God be not silent be not speechless be not still O God
verses.literalPt: Ó Deus, não guardes silêncio; não te cales, nem fiques quieto, ó Deus.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā ye·hĕ·mā·yūn ū·mə·śan·’e·ḵā nā·śə·’ū rōš
verses.literal: See how Your enemies rage how Your foes have reared their heads
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que os teus inimigos fazem tumultos, e os que te odeiam alçam a cabeça.

verses.original: עַֽל־ עַ֭מְּךָ יַעֲרִ֣ימוּ ס֑וֹד וְ֝יִתְיָעֲצ֗וּ עַל־ צְפוּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish
verses.literalPt: Formam planos cavilosos contra o teu povo e, juntos, consultam contra os teus protegidos.

verses.original: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא־ יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mə·rū lə·ḵū wə·naḵ·ḥî·ḏêm mig·gō·w wə·lō- yiz·zā·ḵêr šêm- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: saying Come let us erase them as a nation may the name of Israel be remembered no more
verses.literalPt: Eles dizem: Vinde, e destruamo-los para que não constituam nação; assim, não será lembrado mais o nome de Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî nō·w·‘ă·ṣū lêḇ yaḥ·dāw ‘ā·le·ḵā bə·rîṯ yiḵ·rō·ṯū
verses.literal: For with one mind they plot together they form an alliance against You
verses.literalPt: Pois, juntos e unânimes, se têm consultado e contra ti fazem aliança

verses.literal: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites of Moab and the Hagrites
verses.literalPt: as tendas de Edom e os ismaelitas, Moabe e os hagarenos;

verses.original: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḇāl wə·‘am·mō·wn wa·‘ă·mā·lêq pə·le·šeṯ ‘im- yō·šə·ḇê ṣō·wr
verses.literal: of Gebal Ammon and Amalek of Philistia with the people of Tyre
verses.literalPt: Gebal, Amom e Amaleque; a Filístia, com os habitantes de Tiro.

verses.original: גַּם־ אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי־ ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’aš·šūr nil·wāh ‘im·mām hā·yū zə·rō·w·a‘ liḇ·nê- lō·wṭ se·lāh
verses.literal: Even Assyria has joined them lending strength to the sons of Lot Selah
verses.literalPt: A Assíria também está aliada com eles; têm auxiliado aos filhos de Ló. (Selá)

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־ לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh- lā·hem kə·miḏ·yān kə·sî·sə·rā ḵə·yā·ḇîn bə·na·ḥal qî·šō·wn
verses.literal: Do to them as You did to Midian as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon
verses.literalPt: Faze-lhes como fizeste a Midiã, como a Sísera, como a Jabim, junto ao rio Quisom,

verses.original: נִשְׁמְד֥וּ בְֽעֵין־ דֹּ֑אר הָ֥יוּ דֹּ֝֗מֶן לָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: niš·mə·ḏū ḇə·‘ên- dōr hā·yū dō·men lā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground
verses.literalPt: os quais pereceram em En-Dor; tornaram-se como esterco para a terra.

verses.original: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל־ נְסִיכֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯê·mōw nə·ḏî·ḇê·mōw kə·‘ō·rêḇ wə·ḵiz·’êḇ ū·ḵə·ze·ḇaḥ ū·ḵə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ kāl- nə·sî·ḵê·mōw
verses.literal: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna
verses.literalPt: Faze os seus nobres como a Orebe e a Zeebe e os seus príncipes, como a Zebá e a Zalmuna,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: who said Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God
verses.literalPt: os quais disseram: Tomemos para nós as habitações de Deus.

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י שִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ כַגַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝קַ֗שׁ לִפְנֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.literal: Make them like tumbleweed O my God like chaff before the wind
verses.literalPt: Faze-os, Deus meu, como um turbilhão de pó, como palha impelida do vento.

verses.original: כְּאֵ֥שׁ תִּבְעַר־ יָ֑עַר וּ֝כְלֶהָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט הָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kə·’êš tiḇ·‘ar- yā·‘ar ū·ḵə·le·hā·ḇāh tə·la·hêṭ hā·rîm
verses.literal: As fire consumes a forest as a flame sets the mountains ablaze
verses.literalPt: Como o fogo que queima um bosque, e como a chama que abrasa os montes,

verses.literal: so pursue them with Your tempest and terrify them with Your storm
verses.literalPt: assim, persegue-os com a tua procela e amedronta-os com o teu furacão.

verses.original: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mal·lê p̄ə·nê·hem qā·lō·wn wî·ḇaq·šū šim·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Cover their faces with shame that they may seek Your name O LORD
verses.literalPt: Cobre-lhes o rosto de confusão, de sorte que busquem o teu nome, ó Jeová.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֥וּ עֲדֵי־ עַ֗ד וְֽיַחְפְּר֥וּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.literal: May they be ever ashamed . . . and terrified may they perish in disgrace
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados e conturbados para sempre, sejam confundidos e pereçam,

verses.original: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’at·tāh šim·ḵā Yah·weh lə·ḇad·de·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: May they know that You alone whose name is the LORD are Most High over all the earth
verses.literalPt: para que saibam que só tu, cujo nome é Jeová, és o Altíssimo sobre toda a terra.
